title: I.H.S. Molly told me one time I asked her. I have sinned: or no: I have suffered, it is. And the other one? Iron nails ran in.
html_source: Molly gets it wrong of course, Bloom seems to believe her. IHS (Latin) = Jesus The Savior of Men. For more on “I.N.R.I,” see this note.
